record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.kind: board-phase form-switch passive (OnSpotlightChangeEffect in PassiveEffects); no combat effect
record.summary: Passive.BLOSSOM registers one OnSpotlightChangeEffect. It runs on the player's board (shop/preparation phase), not inside a fight. When the effect runs with inSpotlight true (or with SHINY_STONE held, which forces true) a CHERRIM is replaced by CHERRIM_SUNLIGHT through player.transformPokemon; when it runs with inSpotlight false a CHERRIM_SUNLIGHT holding no SHINY_STONE is replaced by CHERRIM. The effect runs only from three callers: Player.onLightChange (the Light synergy was gained or lost), the position-change command (the Pokémon was moved) and the bot board set-up. inSpotlight is computed by the caller as Light synergy active AND (the unit stands on the light cell lightX/lightY OR holds SHINY_STONE). The Shiny Stone item drop also transforms a BLOSSOM holder directly to CHERRIM_SUNLIGHT. The passive changes no stat itself; the form difference is the unit blocks (Cherrim 2 stars hp 180 atk 15 def 4 speDef 4; Cherrim Sunlight 3 stars hp 250 atk 25 def 6 speDef 9; both maxPP 65, range 3, NATURAL_GIFT) plus whatever transformPokemon carries over.
triggers: Player.onLightChange(hasLightActive) after updateSynergies detects Light gained or lost
position-change command when the Pokémon is moved (including onto or off the light cell)

effects.scaling: none: no amount is declared; the effect does not call any stat helper
effects.resolution: player.transformPokemon builds the new form from PokemonFactory, carries permanent stats (carryOverPermanentStats) and dishes, keeps the cell, deletes the old board entry, adds the new one, re-adds each held item (setting shiny for SHINY_CHARM), calls onAcquired and updateSynergies. The stat difference between the forms is the declared unit stats, not a passive amount.

effects.declaredRaw: inSpotlight = Light synergy active and (on light cell or SHINY_STONE held); then forced true inside the effect when SHINY_STONE is held
effects.resolution: the callers pass hasLightActive && (cell match || SHINY_STONE); the effect additionally sets inSpotlight = true for SHINY_STONE holders, so a holder of SHINY_STONE becomes (or stays) CHERRIM_SUNLIGHT whenever the effect runs, even if Light is inactive and the effect was triggered for another reason.

effects.declaredRaw: transform to CHERRIM_SUNLIGHT on item drop
effects.resolution: the Shiny Stone item effect transforms any holder whose passive is BLOSSOM to CHERRIM_SUNLIGHT (also when it already is that form: transformPokemon creates a fresh copy and the stone is added again) and returns true.

conditions: Holder recognised by pokemon.passive === Passive.BLOSSOM (CHERRIM, CHERRIM_SUNLIGHT).
Reversion needs the unit to be CHERRIM_SUNLIGHT with no SHINY_STONE and the effect to run with inSpotlight false (Light synergy inactive, or unit not on the light cell).
The effect is not re-evaluated continuously: only on the callers listed (Light gained/lost, a move, bot setup), plus the Shiny Stone drop.
Only the two names Pkm.CHERRIM and Pkm.CHERRIM_SUNLIGHT are handled; the effect does nothing for another unit with this passive.
record.resetBehaviour: No timer or counter. The form is a persistent board Pokémon replaced by transformPokemon; there is no in-fight state in the passive. The entity.inSpotlight getter in PokemonEntity is a separate in-fight property and is not read by this effect.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: NATURAL_GIFT ability (separate record) is the same for both forms

evidence.note: the whole passive: one OnSpotlightChangeEffect; Shiny Stone forces inSpotlight true; CHERRIM -> CHERRIM_SUNLIGHT when in spotlight, CHERRIM_SUNLIGHT -> CHERRIM when not
effect type applied when a Pokémon enters or leaves the spotlight (apply is a no-op in the base class)
caller 1: when the Light synergy is gained or lost, every board Pokémon's passive effects are run with inSpotlight = hasLightActive and (on the light cell or holding SHINY_STONE)
onLightChange runs only when the Light synergy crosses its first threshold up or down
caller 2: after a Pokémon is moved, inSpotlight = Light synergy active and (new cell is the light cell or SHINY_STONE held)
caller 3: the same computation for bot boards
replaces the board unit by the new form at the same cell, carries permanent stats and dishes, re-adds the held items, calls onAcquired and updateSynergies
when SHINY_STONE is dropped on a BLOSSOM holder it transforms to CHERRIM_SUNLIGHT and re-adds the stone; the effect returns true (item is equipped)
